Suffering defeat against Vodka at the 
Shuka Sho, a frustrated Daiwa Scarlet 
burned with a desire for revenge.

When Vodka proposed a rematch at the
Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup, Daiwa Scarlet...

Accepting the challenge,
she watched Vodka 
walk away, vowing that she would 
definitely win next time.
